highlights.description: New `providers` package: exchange an OAuth 2.0 authorization code for a normalized `OAuthUser` across Google and GitHub, for "Sign in with ..." login flows

added.description: `providers.FetchGoogleUser` / `providers.FetchGitHubUser`: exchange an authorization code and return a provider-neutral `OAuthUser` (ID, email, name, avatar, access and refresh tokens). GitHub users with a private profile email fall back to the primary verified address from the emails endpoint (requires the `user:email` scope)
`providers.FetchGoogleUserWithToken` / `providers.FetchGitHubUserWithToken`: fetch provider-native profiles with an existing access token, using a client bounded by `providers.DefaultTimeout`
`providers.PrimaryVerifiedEmail` and `providers.ErrNoVerifiedEmail`: select a GitHub user's primary verified email, falling back to any verified email
`cmd/jwt_parse`: print a JWT's claims as JSON without verifying its signature, reading the token from the `JWT_PARSE` environment variable

`google/cmd/oauth2web` and `google/cmd/serviceaccount`: runnable examples that load credentials from a credentials set file and fetch the Google userinfo profile, printing only token metadata, never credentials or tokens

tests.description: `providers` coverage using an `httptest` server as token endpoint and provider API: code exchange, Bearer auth, GitHub email and name fallbacks, missing verified email, token-based fetches, and non-200 error reporting
